question: What power source did Team ES2002 first agree on, what addition did their project manager like the idea of, and what did the final design use?
answer: They first agreed to use regular, non-rechargeable batteries. The project manager, Speaker B (Project Manager), liked the idea of adding kinetic power alongside the battery; the final design used battery power only. Citations: [ES2002c] [ES2002d]
